<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="description" content="Passives Einkommen mit Affiliate Marketing — ohne Produkt, ohne Startkapital">
  <title>Oskar Marketing</title>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;0,900;1,700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --bg: #080808;
      --surface: #101010;
      --surface-el: #181818;
      --gold: #C9A84C;
      --gold-light: #E8C96A;
      --gold-border: rgba(201,168,76,0.2);
      --text: #F0EDE8;
      --text-muted: #5a5a5a;
    }

    html { background: var(--bg); }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 52px 20px 44px;
      position: relative;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    body::before {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      opacity: 0.028;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    body::after {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      top: -220px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 700px;
      height: 700px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(201,168,76,0.055) 0%, transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 420px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    /* AVATAR */
    .avatar-wrap {
      position: relative;
      width: 100px;
      height: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.05s forwards;
    }

    .avatar-ring {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -3px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      padding: 3px;
      background: conic-gradient(
        from 0deg,
        #C9A84C 0deg,
        #E8C96A 60deg,
        #C9A84C 120deg,
        #7a6020 180deg,
        #C9A84C 240deg,
        #E8C96A 300deg,
        #C9A84C 360deg
      );
      animation: ring-spin 6s linear infinite;
      -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
      -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
      mask-composite: exclude;
    }

    .avatar-glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(201,168,76,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .avatar-img {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 3px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      width: calc(100% - 6px);
      height: calc(100% - 6px);
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center top;
    }

    @keyframes ring-spin {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    /* NAME */
    .profile-name {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 27px;
      color: var(--gold);
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.15s forwards;
    }

    .profile-handle {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.2s forwards;
    }

    .gold-line {
      width: 36px;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--gold) 50%, transparent);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.25s forwards;
    }

    /* BIO */
    .bio {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      padding: 0 4px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.3s forwards;
    }

    .bio-main {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: #9A9690;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    }

    .bio-hook {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--gold);
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    /* STATS */
    .stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.4s forwards;
    }

    .stat-card {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--surface-el);
      border: 1px solid var(--gold-border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 14px 6px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stat-card::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(201,168,76,0.6), transparent);
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 19px;
      color: var(--gold);
      display: block;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-top: 4px;
      display: block;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* CTA */
    .cta-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.5s forwards;
    }

    .cta-btn {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 20px 24px 18px;
      background: linear-gradient(110deg, #A07828 0%, #C9A84C 25%, #E8C96A 50%, #C9A84C 75%, #A07828 100%);
      background-size: 300% 100%;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 14px;
      text-decoration: none;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(201,168,76,0.22), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      animation: shimmer 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
      transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease;
    }

    .cta-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(201,168,76,0.18); }

    .cta-eyebrow {
      display: block;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(8,8,8,0.6);
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .cta-title {
      display: block;
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 22px;
      color: #0a0a0a;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .cta-price {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: rgba(8,8,8,0.65);
      margin-top: 5px;
    }

    .cta-sub {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: rgba(8,8,8,0.5);
      margin-top: 6px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    @keyframes shimmer {
      0%,100% { background-position: 0% 0; }
      50% { background-position: 100% 0; }
    }

    /* DIVIDER */
    .section-divider {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.6s forwards;
    }

    .section-divider::before {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(201,168,76,0.18));
    }

    .section-divider::after {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(201,168,76,0.18), transparent);
    }

    .section-divider span {
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.24em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #404040;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* SOCIALS */
    .socials {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.7s forwards;
    }

    .social-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 15px 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      border-radius: 10px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--text);
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
    }

    .social-link:hover, .social-link:active {
      transform: scale(1.04);
      border-color: var(--gold-border);
      background: rgba(201,168,76,0.07);
    }

    .social-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; fill: #C8C4BE; }

    .social-name {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #C8C4BE;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    /* FOOTER */
    .footer {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: #282828;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-align: center;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.85s forwards;
    }

    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation: none !important;
        transition: none !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        transform: none !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container">

    <!-- AVATAR -->
    <div class="avatar-wrap">
      <div class="avatar-glow"></div>
      <div class="avatar-ring"></div>
      <img class="avatar-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Oskar Marketing" loading="eager">
    </div>

    <!-- NAME -->
    <h1 class="profile-name">Oskar Marketing</h1>
    <p class="profile-handle">@oskarmarketing</p>
    <div class="gold-line"></div>

    <!-- BIO -->
    <div class="bio">
      <p class="bio-main">Passives Einkommen mit Affiliate Marketing&nbsp;—<br>ohne Produkt, ohne Startkapital</p>
      <span class="bio-hook">Erkennst du dich wieder?</span>
    </div>

    <!-- STATS -->
    <div class="stats">
      <div class="stat-card">
        <span class="stat-value">0€</span>
        <span class="stat-label">Startkapital</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <span class="stat-value">30</span>
        <span class="stat-label">Tage System</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <span class="stat-value">5-stlg</span>
        <span class="stat-label">Monatsziel</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CTA -->
    <div class="cta-wrap">
      <a href="https://www.theaffiliateacademy.de" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="cta-btn">
        <span class="cta-eyebrow">Jetzt starten</span>
        <span class="cta-title">Affiliate Academy</span>
        <span class="cta-price">ab 5&nbsp;&euro; / Monat</span>
        <span class="cta-sub">&#10022; Schritt-f&uuml;r-Schritt System</span>
      </a>
    </div>

    <!-- DIVIDER -->
    <div class="section-divider"><span>Follow me</span></div>

    <!-- SOCIALS -->
    <div class="socials">

        <svg class="social-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19.59 6.69a4.83 4.83 0 01-3.77-4.25V2h-3.45v13.67a2.89 2.89 0 01-2.88 2.5 2.89 2.89 0 01-2.89-2.89 2.89 2.89 0 012.89-2.89c.28 0 .54.04.79.1V9.01a6.34 6.34 0 00-.79-.05 6.34 6.34 0 00-6.34 6.34 6.34 6.34 0 006.34 6.34 6.34 6.34 0 006.33-6.34V8.97a8.28 8.28 0 004.84 1.54V7.07a4.85 4.85 0 01-1.07-.38z"/></svg>
        <span class="social-name">TikTok</span>
      </a>
      <a href="https://www.instagram.com/oskarmarketing" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="social-link">
        <svg class="social-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2.163c3.204 0 3.584.012 4.85.07 3.252.148 4.771 1.691 4.919 4.919.058 1.265.069 1.645.069 4.849 0 3.205-.012 3.584-.069 4.849-.149 3.225-1.664 4.771-4.919 4.919-1.266.058-1.644.07-4.85.07-3.204 0-3.584-.012-4.849-.07-3.26-.149-4.771-1.699-4.919-4.92-.058-1.265-.07-1.644-.07-4.849 0-3.204.013-3.583.07-4.849.149-3.227 1.664-4.771 4.919-4.919 1.266-.057 1.645-.069 4.849-.069zm0-2.163c-3.259 0-3.667.014-4.947.072-4.358.2-6.78 2.618-6.98 6.98-.059 1.281-.073 1.689-.073 4.948 0 3.259.014 3.668.072 4.948.2 4.358 2.618 6.78 6.98 6.98 1.281.058 1.689.072 4.948.072 3.259 0 3.668-.014 4.948-.072 4.354-.2 6.782-2.618 6.979-6.98.059-1.28.073-1.689.073-4.948 0-3.259-.014-3.667-.072-4.947-.196-4.354-2.617-6.78-6.979-6.98-1.281-.059-1.69-.073-4.949-.073zm0 5.838a6.162 6.162 0 100 12.324 6.162 6.162 0 000-12.324zM12 16a4 4 0 110-8 4 4 0 010 8zm6.406-11.845a1.44 1.44 0 100 2.881 1.44 1.44 0 000-2.881z"/></svg>
        <span class="social-name">Instagram</span>
      </a>
      <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@oskarmarketing" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="social-link">
        <svg class="social-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M23.498 6.186a3.016 3.016 0 00-2.122-2.136C19.505 3.545 12 3.545 12 3.545s-7.505 0-9.377.505A3.017 3.017 0 00.502 6.186C0 8.07 0 12 0 12s0 3.93.502 5.814a3.016 3.016 0 002.122 2.136c1.871.505 9.376.505 9.376.505s7.505 0 9.377-.505a3.015 3.015 0 002.122-2.136C24 15.93 24 12 24 12s0-3.93-.502-5.814zM9.545 15.568V8.432L15.818 12l-6.273 3.568z"/></svg>
        <span class="social-name">YouTube</span>

        <span class="social-name">Threads</span>
      </a>
    </div>

    <!-- FOOTER -->
    <p class="footer">&copy; 2025 Oskar Marketing &middot; Affiliate Marketing</p>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
